title: Quarterly Tranche Plan — Private Instance Capacity, Compatibility, and OKR Attribution
creator: Aisha Patel
description: This ticket defines a tranche-based quarterly roadmap to sequence Private/VPC/on-prem feature delivery with explicit capacity hedging, compatibility signal checks, and OKR-level attribution. The goal is to produce a timeboxed plan that gates delivery by interoperability and operational readiness signals while mapping each tranche to measurable OKR submetrics (activation rate, MTTR, revenue uplift).
background: Customers increasingly request predictable activation windows and guaranteed capacity for isolated deployments. Previous quarter launches exposed contention in dedicated pools and unclear signal-to-OKR linkage. We need a coordinated tranche strategy that reduces risk during rollouts by: (1) reserving capacity hedges per tranche, (2) formalizing compatibility checks against customer configurations, and (3) surfacing OKR telemetry tied to each rollout cohort.
objectives: Define three tranches (Pilot, Ramp, GA) with explicit capacity hedges and rollback thresholds
Create compatibility signal checklist and automated verifier for common on-prem configurations
Map each tranche to OKR metrics and dashboard slices for attribution
Publish runbook for tranche activation, rollback, and customer communication

2026-03-24: Compatibility verifier PoC (config-checker v0.1) and integration tests complete

2026-05-12: Ramp tranche readiness gate review and autoscaling policy validated
2026-05-31: GA tranche sign-off and public customer activation calendar published
acceptance_criteria: Tranche definitions documented with capacity hedging numbers per cohort
Compatibility verifier runs against top 10 enterprise customer configs and produces deterministic pass/fail
OKR attribution events appear in Console telemetry with <5s ingestion latency
Runbook includes rollback thresholds, contact matrix, and estimated failure budget
Cross-team sign-off from Eng infra, SRE, Security, and Sales Ops obtained
success_metrics: Pilot activation success rate >= 95% (no critical production impact)
Mean time to rollback (if triggered) < 30 minutes
OKR signal: 10% increase in private deployment activations QoQ attributed to this tranche process
Failure budget consumption <= 1.5% during Ramp tranche
risks: Capacity forecasting mismatch: hedges undersized for a high-churn cohort
Compatibility detector false negatives for unusual network topologies
Telemetry gaps preventing accurate OKR attribution during fast rollouts
Cross-team resource contention delays tranche readiness gate
